feature: SUPPORTED-only localization with defect-signal file ranking
problem: D2=0.201 (target 0.25). report_builder.py emits LocalizationClaim for every hypothesis with a non-empty file, including SPECULATIVE and REFUTED tiers. Speculative files dilute Jaccard precision against the true fix-commit files.
proposed_solution: Extract _build_localization(hypotheses, tagged, raw_diff) helper. Filter to tag.tier==SUPPORTED and h.file non-empty. Rank SUPPORTED claims by: (1) defect-signal file match from smart_diff._file_rank==0, (2) production file, (3) longer evidence_quote, (4) original index as stable tie-break. Zero new LLM calls.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Unit test: when all hypotheses are SPECULATIVE or REFUTED, localization == []
AC-2: Unit test: with mixed tiers (2 SUPPORTED + 2 SPECULATIVE), localization contains exactly 2 claims from the SUPPORTED hypotheses only
AC-3: Unit test: when multiple SUPPORTED hypotheses exist, the one whose file matches defect-signal tier (smart_diff._file_rank==0) is ranked first in localization
AC-4: build_report() integration: localization output never contains a claim from a non-SUPPORTED hypothesis (verified by checking the corresponding tag in the test)
AC-5: 415+ pytest pass; no existing test regressions
edge_cases: EC-1: Zero SUPPORTED hypotheses → localization=[] (not error, not None)
EC-2: SUPPORTED hypothesis with empty h.file → excluded from localization (same rule as before)
EC-3: raw_diff is None → skip defect-signal ranking; preserve SUPPORTED hypotheses in original order
EC-4: Multiple SUPPORTED hypotheses on same file → deduplicate by (file, lines) keeping first after ranking
constraints: No new LLM calls — pure deterministic post-processing
Do not modify findings or recommendations — only localization changes
No re-score script required for contract verification (D2 lift confirmed at mini-n20-gate)
